summary: On the main deck, Tank watches a monitor showing Neo's path. He traces Neo's progress with his finger and exclaims that Neo is almost there, directing him to the fire escape at the end of the alley.

what_changes.before: tracking Neo's path on the monitor
what_changes.after: recognizing Neo has reached the escape route
what_changes.evidence: Finger on the monitor, Tank traces Neo's path.

event_hint.one_line: Tank tracks Neo's escape on the monitor, guiding him to the fire escape at the end of the alley.
